title: Fire Emblem Engage Manga Heads Towards Climax
content: Kazurō Kyō announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Tuesday that the Fire Emblem Engage manga adaptation of Nintendo 's strategy RPG will reach its climax soon. Kyō launched the manga in Shueisha 's Saikyō Jump magazine and on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ website and app in May 2023.

title: Magical Craft: My Enchanted Dress Shop Switch Game Heads West
content: Imagineer announced on Tuesday that it will release syn Sophia 's Magical Craft: My Enchanted Dress Shop ( Magical Craft: Neko to Maho no Dress ) life simulation game physically and digitally in the West for Nintendo Switch on October 2. In the game, players can create dresses. More designs unlock upon leveling up.

title: Cancelled Shonen Jump Manga Confirms Return Ahead of Anime Revival
content: One cancelled Shonen Jump hit has confirmed that the manga is returning for a new release as it prepares to get revived with a whole new anime this Summer.
